svg.aria-label: Looking up key 251 in a B-tree index. The root page holds the boundaries 100, 200 and 300, so the search follows the pointer for keys 200 to 300. That child page splits the range further into 200 to 250, 250 to 270 and 270 to 300, so the search follows the pointer for 250 to 270. The leaf page holds keys 250 to 270 in order, including 251 with its row or a pointer to it. Three page reads find any key among billions.
